artworks.title: Martin Luther
artworks.artist: Albrecht Altdorfer after Lucas Cranach the Elder
artworks.description: The image displays a side profile of a man's head and upper torso. The person is facing to the right with a slight upward tilt to the face. His facial features include a prominent, slightly pointed nose, a strong chin, and thoughtfully pursed lips. He has short hair and a slight suggestion of facial hair. The man is wearing a robe and a cap on his head. Surrounding him is an ornate circular frame decorated with leafy patterns. Above his head, there's a plaque with the letters "D·M·L". The background features intricate vine and floral motifs as a decorative border.

artworks.title: Pyramus and Thisbe
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a forest scene featuring two figures. The foreground of the image is filled with the figures—one clad in armor lying on the ground, and another seated with raised arms. The landscape consists of detailed trees with dense foliage. In the background, there is a structure resembling a castle on a hill. The drawing is characterized by fine linework and crosshatching, creating texture and depth in a style akin to a woodcut or engraving.

artworks.title: Samson and Delilah
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of an adult and a partial view of a child. The adult figure is in a crouched position, holding a pair of scissors, and appears to be cutting the child’s hair. The adult has a visible face with delicate features, including a downturned gaze, and is wearing a headscarf that covers their hair. The child's face is facing away from the viewer, showing curly hair. The clothing of the adult is detailed with folds and textures, featuring a long dress with puffed sleeves. The child wears a simple one-piece outfit without visible footwear. The background features a stone wall with two small windows, and part of a building with a slanted roof is visible on the left. There is also a large tree trunk on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Solomon Praying to the Idols
artworks.description: The image shows a statue within an architectural setting with two figures in front of it. The persons, both standing on the right side, wear elaborate clothing and appear to be pointing towards the statue. The statue, positioned in a niche on the left, stands on an ornately carved pedestal. It depicts a figure with long hair and flowing garments, holding an object. At the base of the statue is a framed picture or mirror. The background comprises tall columns and arches, likely representing a significant structure, with walls adorned with tall windows.

artworks.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
artworks.description: The image shows a standing figure with classical features and a helmet-like headpiece. The figure is carrying a staff topped with a lion-like head and is dressed in a draped garment. The background has a lined texture and a visible architectural feature. A sun-like motif is partially obscured by the drapery.

artworks.title: The Virgin Seeking Jesus in the Temple
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural interior with columns and arches. In the foreground, a figure is wrapped around a column, shown in detail. The background shows a series of archways and columns, creating depth in the space. The architectural features are highlighted with fine line work and attention to texture. A small circular window is visible in the backdrop. The composition suggests a moment of quiet activity or reflection in a large hall or cloister.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child and Saint Anne
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in full view. The person on the left is standing upright, holding a child in their arms. The person on the right is bent over slightly, facing the person on the left. Both individuals have halos around their heads. The figure on the left has a covered head, with mature facial features, a beard, and the child they are holding has curly hair. The figure on the right is wearing a hat, and their facial features are less discernible due to the position. The person on the left is draped in robes, and the child is also wrapped in cloth, while the person on the right appears to be wearing a garment with a checkered texture and decorative elements. The object next to the leaning figure resembles a crib or type of container with a radiating design above it. The background consists of a simple lined texture, implying an interior setting with no distinct features beyond the figures.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure carrying a child across a river. The scene shows a muscular figure holding onto a tree branch for support as they wade through the water. The child, perched on the shoulders of the larger figure, reaches skyward with one hand. The background includes rolling hills and a village dominated by a prominent church spire. The rays of the sun or a glowing light source illuminate the figures. The detailed crosshatching and linework give texture to the figures and surrounding scenery.

artworks.title: Triumph of the Sea-Gods
artworks.description: The image depicts mythological creatures and horses in a dynamic scene. The figures are engaged in various actions, such as riding chariots and interacting with the horses. The characters are adorned with wreaths and the setting appears to be celebratory or ritualistic. The horses exhibit exaggerated expressions and dynamic postures. The artwork is detailed with linear shading and careful outlines similar to Renaissance etchings or engravings.

artworks.title: Neptune on a Sea Monster
artworks.description: The image shows a seated male figure resting on a creature with a dragon-like head. The figure has curly hair and is nude, holding a trident in one hand and cloth in the other arm. The background has horizontal lines, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Crouching Venus
artworks.description: The image shows a nude woman crouched with her body angled to the side. Her right hand is on her ear while her left arm rests across her knees. She has a rounded face, full lips, and eyes looking to her left. Her hair is styled with curls framing her face. A cherub with wings stands behind her, appearing to gesture towards her hair. The cherub is also nude with spread wings. To the woman's left, there is a potted plant with ornate leaves or flowers. The background features vertical lines and possible architectural elements, hinting at a classical or mythological setting.

artworks.title: Venus after the Bath
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated nude figure and a cherub-like figure. The scene depicts a seated figure placing a garment over their knee while a small cherubic figure stands beside them, holding a staff and having wings. The setting includes draped fabric behind the figures and a round object placed on the ground nearby. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of engravings from the Renaissance period. The use of detailed lines and shading gives depth to the figures and surroundings.

artworks.title: Hercules and a Muse
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a man and a woman, standing side by side. The man is on the left, slightly turned towards the woman. He has curly hair and holds a lit candle holder. The woman stands on the right with her head tilted to the side and holds a thin fabric. Both figures are unclothed and stand on a textured surface. Between them is a large harp-like object with a crown on top. The background features intricate foliage, a tree trunk, and a curtain of leaves across the top.

artworks.title: Hercules Overcoming the Nemean Lion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a human figure interacting with a lion. The human figure is kneeling and grappling with the lion, with one hand holding the lion's mane and the other keeping its jaw open. The lion is depicted lying down, with detailed muscles and fur. The human figure appears to be in motion, indicated by flowing lines suggesting movement and tension. The drawing utilizes fine lines and shading commonly seen in early printmaking, adding a dramatic intensity to the scene.

artworks.title: Hercules Bearing the Column of Gades
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a muscular humanoid figure carrying two large cylindrical structures on its shoulders. The figure is scantily clad with a garment draped from the waist. The background features a landscape with hills, structures, and undulating terrain. The drawing is intricately detailed with fine linework, showcasing an etching technique.

artworks.title: Mucius Scaevola Burning His Hand
artworks.description: The image shows a nude individual with a cloth around the waist, reaching out towards a fire burning in a bowl on a pedestal. The individual wears a decorated helmet with feathers and has a focused expression. The background features swirling lines and patterns.

artworks.title: The Suicide of Dido
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length figure of a person standing in a poised position. One foot is raised slightly off the ground as they appear balanced. The person's head is turned slightly to their right with a focused expression. They have a defined nose, lips, and eyes looking forward. Their long, wavy hair reaches past their shoulders and is adorned with a single circular accessory at the top. The person wears a flowing garment with a fitted bodice and a voluminous skirt that reaches down to their ankles. The garment has long sleeves, and the figure holds a dagger in one hand, pointed downwards. They wear a bracelet with circular beads on their right wrist. The person stands on a rectangular surface with swirling lines in the background, adding movement around the figure.

artworks.title: Horatius Cocles Leaping into the River Tiber
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a dynamic and dramatic position. The individual is depicted in detailed armor with a helmet obscuring their facial features. They are gripping a large ring attached to a beam above and their other hand is raised with the palm facing outward. Waves flow around their feet indicating movement through water. The background reveals a landscape with a distant structure resembling a tent, hinting at a possible encampment or fortification. The scene is rendered in intricate shading resembling engravings.

artworks.title: Putto Riding a Hobby Horse
artworks.description: The image shows a cherubic figure standing in a dynamic pose on grass. The figure is holding a bow in its left hand and an arrow in its right hand. The cherub has curly hair around its face, small wings on its back, and is depicted in a classic artistic style. The background has horizontal lines for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Putto Holding a Shield with the Monogram of Altdorfer
artworks.description: In this print, a winged person is depicted crouching and grasping a shield-like object. The object resembles a coat of arms, bordered by decorative flourishes reminiscent of heraldic design. On the shield is a large symbol similar to a capital letter A with a flat top. The person is bent low, looking down at the shield. One of their legs is visible, stepping forward on a grassy hill.

artworks.title: Two Satyrs Fighting about a Nymph
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures in a woodland setting. The image depicts several figures with exaggerated, muscular forms and dynamic poses. The upper section shows intricate line work representing tree foliage, while the figures are defined by detailed shading that highlights their muscles and expressive faces. The central figure appears to be reaching out or wielding an object, with an engaged stance. The scene has a feel reminiscent of a dynamic narrative in a fantasy or mythological context. The drawing features fine lines suggestive of early woodcuts or etchings.

artworks.title: Winged Woman on a Star
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure standing above a landscape with a castle. The figure is nude with flowing hair, large feathered wings, one hand holding a rod with drapery and the other hand holding a plume. The figure stands atop a bright light source that illuminates the landscape below with a castle, trees, and winding pathways. The artwork features intricate linework and shading suggesting careful etching techniques.

artworks.title: The Pensive Carpenter
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting with his head resting on his left hand and his elbow leaning on a windowsill or ledge, while his right arm rests across his lap. He has a focused expression and wears a cap on his head. The man is dressed in a long-sleeved tunic with a belt at his waist, knee-length pants, and ankle boots. He is holding a rectangular block of wood or a similar object. The background features a textured wall and a cylindrical object hanging from the ceiling, possibly a lantern.
